reviews.comment: Really loved her!! Very knowledgable. Not an easy A- you need to study and take notes! She really cared about the material she was teaching, so it was inspiring. Overall a great experience.

Everyones hating on Doherty but her class was actually quite fair and I enjoyed our class discussions and lessons. The exams are open note online and the slides and videos are really all you need to do well. As long as you put in the work to look over notes you can get an A.

Caitlin is a nice, passionate person but she speaks really fast and changes topics too soon so its hard to keep up with her. Most info was completely new to me so I had no background knowledge to help me learn the material better. There is a lot of reading and videos that you have to know tiny details about or your exam grades will suffer. Easy hw
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Caitlin was super passionate about anthropology and her lectures were so amazing. But, her lectures never really related back to her test and it was just a lot of memorizing. The class is interesting but what you retain from class won't be what you will see on the test.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She's super passionate about anthropology but her tests are more like history exams so it makes the tests a little more challenging to study for. There are other assignments other than exams to help with exam grades but take those seriously.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Instructor Doherty was very passionate about anthropology, but this was her first semester teaching and I feel like our class sort of got the short end of the stick because of that. Powerpoints were posted days-weeks after the original lecture in class which made it hard to study with reasonable time. She doesn't round at all, an 89 is a B.
Her tests were extremely difficult. They were 100 very detail oriented questions. Attendance was not mandatory but most of the test questions came from the lecture slides.
reviews.ratingTags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She is very passionate about anthropology so she would often lose track of class time telling interesting stories. She provided slides of information and expected you to know everything on the test. The tests are 100 questions but are pretty difficult even if you did study. You have to basically memorize/learn every little detail from the lectures.
